personality_one_liner: A warm, structured, and trustworthy environment for a community-driven circular economy.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding to let content breathe. Avoid dense dashboard grids; use modular cards for marketplace items.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to allow map and feeds to scroll behind.
Use blur on sticky headers when scrolling down feeds.
Use blur on bottom sheets over the map for 'Puntos de Trueque' details.
dont's: Do not blur standard list rows or form fields.
Do not over-stack blur on blur.

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: A hybrid social and marketplace feed showing friends' activities and local barter chains.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a faint 'Cargando trueques...' text.
states.empty: Illustration of hands exchanging items + 'No hay actividad reciente. ¡Añade amigos o explora!' + Primary CTA to Discover.

screens.layout: Vertical scroll feed. Each post card has an avatar row (social), an image of the item/service (marketplace), and action buttons for 'Me interesa' or 'Comentar'. Use surfaceSecondary cards with lg margins on a surface background.

screens.name: MapDiscover
screens.purpose: Interactive map highlighting 'Puntos de Trueque' (local cafes, restaurants) and nearby users.

states.empty: Map centered on default location, 'No hay puntos cercanos' overlay.
states.error: Failed to load map data + retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed map under safe areas. Sticky search bar with glassmorphism at the top. When a pin is tapped, a Gorhom Bottom Sheet slides up showing the cafe/restaurant details and their accepted barter items.

screens.name: BodegaProfile
screens.purpose: The user's personal warehouse showing 'Lo que ofrezco' and 'Mi Lista de Deseos'.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty shelf + 'Tu bodega está vacía' + CTA to add the first item.

screens.layout: Profile header (avatar, name, followers). Segmented control (sticky with glassmorphism) switching between 'Bodega' (2-column grid of offered items) and 'Deseos' (list of needed items).

screens.name: AddItemForm
screens.purpose: Flexible form to add a product or service to the Bodega.
screens.layout: Single column scrollable form. Fields for description, estimated value in local currency, category tags (brandTertiary chips), and 'What I want in exchange'. Primary CTA pinned to the bottom of the screen above keyboard.

vintage_camera.alt: Classic analog camera for a barter example

stack_of_books.alt: Stack of vintage books for barter example

coffee_shop_facade.alt: Coffee shop facade serving as a barter point

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'iOS-Native Clean' guidelines. Avoid dense dashboards; utilize 'md' and 'lg' spacing to let the marketplace feel approachable and trustworthy.
Implement the primary color palette based on earthy tones (Sage Green and Terracotta) to reinforce the circular economy vibe. Strictly NO BLUES or PURPLES in the UI.
For the Map screen, utilize @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the map pin details (Puntos de Trueque), and ensure glassmorphism is applied to the bottom sheet handle/header.
Use a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) whenever placing text over image cards (e.g., in the Bodega grid).
In the Add Item form, ensure the Submit button is sticky at the bottom using KeyboardAvoidingView, independent of the scrolling content.
Wire subtle haptics directly on tab changes, form submissions, and primary marketplace actions (like expressing interest).
Default to Light mode. Dark mode should use lifted surfaces (surfaceSecondary lighter than surface) rather than inversion.
Incorporate the provided real images for user avatars and placeholder barter items to give the app a polished, populated feel right out of the box.
